description: This PHP class 'ServicePeriod' extends 'FilterField' and is part of the OrangeHRM system. It provides functionality to add date-based filtering to database queries related to employee service periods, with support for operators like less than, greater than, and between. It uses traits and query builder wrappers to construct dynamic SQL expressions for filtering employees based on their tenure.

classes.name: ServicePeriod
classes.description: Handles date-based filtering for employee service periods in reports, supporting operators like less than, greater than, and between, utilizing date difference calculations.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds filtering conditions to the query builder based on the operator and value(s) provided, calculating date differences between the current date and employee joining date.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the entity alias 'employee' used in query conditions.
